page: Vultr vcg-mi325x-252c-2872g-1536vram is a Dedicated Metal GPU server designed for high-density compute and acceleration. The system features 252 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs paired with 2872.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 11.4 GB of RAM per core.

The primary accelerator architecture consists of six AMD MI325X GPUs from the CDNA3 family, delivering a combined total of 1536 GB of VRAM. Local storage is provided by 14336 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, supporting high-throughput data access. The server also includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Given the massive scale of the hardware, this bare-metal configuration offers high resource density, consolidating substantial compute, memory, and accelerator capacity into a single dedicated node. This design minimizes network overhead between multiple smaller nodes, making it highly efficient for large-scale workloads. The server is suited for heavy GPU-accelerated tasks, large language model training, complex data science jobs, and high-capacity database operations.
